item.title: [rfc7233] Content suggestion: http content-type multipart/*
item.content:encoded:
What is the new suggestion?

I couldn't find any content related to the Content-Type: multipart/x-mixed-replace or other multipart/... headers except for multipart/byteranges in the 206 status code

Why is it important or useful?

It is supported by firefox, chrome and safari:

  • https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=MIME&oldid=1103600744#Multipart_subtypes
  • https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=MIME&oldid=1103600744#x-mixed-replace
  • Example test server for firefox with multipart/mixed: https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/source/netwerk/test/unit/test_multipart_streamconv-byte-by-byte.js#19

Other supporting information

Some specs (extracted from wikipedia):

  • multipart/mixed: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-5.1.3
  • multipart/digest: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2046#section-5.1.5
  • multipart/alternative: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2046#section-5.1.4
  • multipart/related: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2387
  • multipart/report: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6522

Example server demonstrating multipart/x-mixed-replace: https://github.com/yscoder/multipart-x-mixed-replace-example
